guide.step1Desc: Connect any Solana wallet (Phantom, Backpack, Seed Vault on Seeker) to get started. Your wallet is your identity on SolTrivia.
guide.step2Desc: Every wallet gets one free entry per round (no life consumed). Entry fee (0.0225 SOL) still applies. To re-enter the same round (up to 5 times), you'll need lives.
guide.step3Desc: Lives let you enter paid rounds. Buy in bulk: 3 for 0.03 SOL, 15 for 0.1 SOL, or 35 for 0.25 SOL. Seeker holders get discounted rates. Lives never expire.
guide.step4Desc: 4 rounds run daily (every 6 hours UTC). Each entry costs 0.02 SOL to the prize pool + 0.0025 SOL platform fee. Max 5 entries per round, 20 per day.
guide.step5Desc: Each round gives you 10 trivia questions across crypto, science, history, and more. You have 10 seconds per question — no pausing.
guide.step6Desc: Every correct answer earns 100 base points + up to 900 bonus points for speed. The faster you answer, the higher your score. Max 1,000 pts per question.
guide.step7Desc: Once a round has 5+ finishers, the entire prize pool is split among the top 5: 1st gets 50%, 2nd 20%, 3rd 15%, 4th 10%, 5th 5%. Zero platform deduction from the pot.
guide.step8Desc: Winners are posted on-chain after each round. Claim your SOL directly from the smart contract — fully verifiable and trustless.
guide.step9Desc: Create your own trivia games with custom questions, share a link, and challenge friends. Free with a Game Pass, or 0.0225 SOL per game.
guide.step10Desc: Challenge another player head-to-head in real-time. Pick your wager (0.01 to 1 SOL), answer the same questions, and the winner takes the pot.
guide.fairPlayLimits: Fair play limits: max 5 entries per round, 20 per 24 hours. 4 rounds daily (every 6h UTC).

faq.title: FAQ
faq.a1: Sol Trivia is a crypto-themed trivia game on Solana. Answer questions to earn points, compete against other players, and win real SOL prizes from the pot each round.
faq.a2: Connect your Solana wallet, pay 0.0225 SOL (0.02 entry + 0.0025 platform fee), and answer 10 questions, 10 seconds each. Top 5 players win SOL.
faq.a3: 100% of the pot goes to the top 5: 1st 50%, 2nd 20%, 3rd 15%, 4th 10%, 5th 5%. No platform cut from the pot. Winners claim on-chain from their Profile.
faq.a4: 4 rounds per day (every 6 hours UTC: 00:00, 06:00, 12:00, 18:00). Entry caps: 5 per round, 20 per 24 hours. Game Pass holders get 10 per round, 40 per 24 hours.
faq.a5: Free trivia with no wallet required. 5 practice runs per day (unlimited with Game Pass). Separate questions, 12-second timer, no prizes or leaderboard.
faq.a6: Your first entry per round is free of life cost (entry fee still applies). Re-entries cost 1 life. Buy lives in 3 USD-pegged tiers: $3 = 5 lives, $10 = 20 lives, $20 = 50 lives. Pay in SOL, USDC, SKR, or NERD. Seekers save 35%.
faq.a7: A subscription: $10/mo or $85/yr ($6.50/mo or $55/yr for Seekers). Pay in SOL, USDC, SKR, or NERD (10% off when paying with NERD). Perks: +3 lives per purchase, 2x XP on quests, daily streak protection, 10/40 entry caps, free custom game creation, unlimited practice, all 7 categories, 10% off lives, +25% XP per round.
faq.a8: Build your own trivia with custom questions. Players join via link or code. Prize models: free, player-funded SOL/SPL, creator-funded SOL/SPL/NFT. Per-game leaderboard with on-chain prize claims.
faq.q9: How much does it cost to create a Custom Game?
faq.a9: Without Game Pass: 0.0075 SOL (0.005 creation fee + 0.0025 platform fee). Game Pass holders skip the creation fee and pay only the 0.0025 platform fee.
faq.a10: Real-time 1v1 trivia battles. Wager SOL, USDC, or any SPL token. Pick an amount, create or join, and battle through 5 questions, 10 seconds each. Winner takes the pot (10% house cut).
faq.a11: Both players put up the same wager (+ 0.0025 SOL platform fee each). Highest score wins, time breaks ties. The contract resolves on-chain and the winner claims from their Profile.
faq.q12: What happens if my Duel expires?
faq.a12: If no opponent joins within 24 hours, the duel can be cancelled and the creator gets a full refund on-chain. You can also cancel a waiting duel at any time before an opponent joins.
faq.a13: Verify your Solana Seeker Genesis Token (SGT) for +25% XP boost, 35% off lives + Game Pass, .skr domain as display name, and a Seeker badge on the leaderboard.
faq.q14: How does the Referral Program work?
faq.a14: Share your link from the Referrals page. You earn 1,000 XP when a referee completes their first paid game, plus on-chain commissions: 5% of every Lives purchase and 10% of every Game Pass purchase. Claim earnings on Referrals.
faq.a15: We never have access to your private keys or seed phrases. All transactions need your explicit wallet approval. Funds go directly to the on-chain contract vault or revenue wallet, never to a personal address.
faq.q16: What are Sol Trivia Elementals NFTs?
faq.a16: A 100K-supply commemorative NFT collection minted on Solana. 4 archetypes, all classified Legendary. 0.02 SOL to mint (0.01 SOL for Seekers). Mint goes live with the V2.1 contract upgrade.
faq.q17: Can I swap tokens in the app?
faq.a17: Yes. The Swap page (Jupiter-powered) lets you swap SOL, USDC, SKR, NERD, and any verified Solana token. Fake NERD impersonators are blocked. Jupiter Verified badge shows on legit tokens.
faq.q18: What is the streak protection perk?
faq.a18: If you have an active Game Pass and miss a day, your streak auto-restores once per 30 days. You can build long streaks without worrying about a missed day breaking them.
